item.desc:stick: Split from planks. Every haft and arrow shaft starts as one.
item.desc:coal: Old timber gone black in the rock, or a log charred in a furnace. It burns a long time.
item.desc:flint: Picked out of gravel. Knapped, it takes an edge and heads the plainest arrows.
item.desc:fiber: Pulled from tall grass, fern and reeds. Cord, thatch and bedding are made of it.
item.desc:feather: Grouse feather, or what a Jatu took from the birds it caught. It fletches arrows.
item.desc:hide: Off sheep and boar, and off feeders that ran some animal down. Every holder's bed is covered in it.
item.desc:bone: What is left in the pot when a kill is boiled down. Nothing loosens it.
item.desc:iron_bar: Iron run out of its rock in a furnace fire. It is the last metal won without killing anything large.
item.desc:gold_bar: Soft, and it stays soft under the hammer. It holds no edge, and a feeder gets nothing from it.
item.desc:lumenite: A clear gem of the deep rock with a cold light. No fire touches it. It is split along its joints on the anvil's edge.
item.desc:mana_crystal: Old lees, set hard where nothing ate it. Driven through a cut line, it loosens what it is pointed at.
item.desc:cinder_bar: Iron that ran with the molten rock and set again deep down. Only Maruhar Remains loosen its ore.
item.desc:umbrite_bar: Metal of the hollow's rock. Nobody has seen it soft before it set, so nobody can say if it is iron.
item.desc:noctrium_bar: The hollow's metal from its lower half, nearer the floor, and set harder for it.
item.desc:aether_bar: The common metal of the islands, cut over drops that do not land.
item.desc:prism_bar: Island metal with crystal grown through it. It neither splits like a gem nor bends like plain metal.
item.desc:eclipse_bar: Iron from the lowest rock, lying on the floor itself, with lees set all through it. It gives a violet light.
item.desc:weave: Fibre laid round crystal on the Line Frame: a cut line made up as cloth.
item.desc:effigy: Bone carved to take raw Tama flesh, bound on. The flesh is food, and a small feeder forms on it.
item.desc:gel: The jelly a Kinva forms in, rotted out of fallen growth. It goes into the Vanahar Likeness.
item.desc:thorn: Bramble off a Kantak. Set in an arm guard, it cuts whatever strikes the guard.
item.desc:shade_essence: Raw Tama flesh, dark with the feeders it fed on. Bells, totems and the bone whistle are packed with it.
item.desc:ember_dust: Dust of the coal an Angār forms round. It burns longer than coal.
item.desc:chitin: Plate off a Silahādak. It is scale of the stone the animal ate.
item.desc:frost_fang: A tooth out of a Vaka. Its kind hunts the cold country at night, and the sun does it no harm.
item.desc:bog_pearl: Lees that set in mud where nothing found it. Kaddam swallow it with the mud they lie in.
item.desc:rust_core: Rust out of a Nihirakka, which is bodied in the harness it ate in a sealed store.
item.desc:spore_sac: Raw spore out of a Kavak. Raw sacs eat through iron.
item.desc:moth_dust: Shed by a Salaha, which is bodied in what falls from the great caps.
item.desc:rift_scale: Scale of a Vihanga. A Kajjot carries one now and then, from a dead Vihanga it had been at.
item.desc:shard: Splintered crystal off a Sakal. Raw, it cuts and loosens whatever holds it.
item.desc:ash_token: Grey glass with ash through it, broken from the floor under a sand-country fire. It charges no pot.
item.desc:moon_sliver: A bit of a Chandasāvak's body, lees set hard and pale. The born say the slivers are pieces of the moon.
item.desc:heartroot: Root of Vanahar that still moves. On a bench it loosens two worked pieces far enough to join them.
item.desc:scorched_core: Grit and deep rock from Maruhar's middle. Woken by fire in a ring of deep rock, it loosens Jalit ore.
item.desc:warden_sigil: Pale matter cut from Kankāl. In a frame of black glass it holds an opening to the hollow.
item.desc:queen_spore: Cap and thread of Guhamāt. In a ring of hollow rock it loosens ore, and the ore never gets hot.
item.desc:storm_plume: The pale stuff of Jīmūt's body. It stands up from the hand however it is held. Some of us say it points at the islands.
item.desc:prism_heart: Crystal from the body of Ratan. Bedded in island rock over a fire, it loosens Patik ore.
item.desc:eclipse_ember: Remains of Kuranga, still giving its kind's violet light. In a ring of black glass it loosens Gahan ore.
item.desc:cairn_heart: Raw remains of Nihān. Boiled down, it would make a charge that turns everything weaker than Nihān.
item.desc:apple: Fruit that drops from oak leaves, eaten as it comes.
item.desc:berries: Picked off wild bushes, mostly in the cold pine woods. The bush fruits again in time.
item.desc:raw_meat: Meat off a sheep, a grouse or a boar. Cooked, it goes much further.
item.desc:cooked_meat: Roasted in a furnace. It feeds a body far better than raw.
item.desc:raw_fish: From open water, where no feeder comes up. Better roasted.
item.desc:cooked_fish: Fish roasted over a furnace fire.
item.desc:stew: Brown and red mushroom boiled together. A plain meal.
item.desc:glow_broth: Glowing mushroom and frond of the hollow, boiled. The caps take up crystal, so it eases the arm a little.
item.desc:skyfruit: Fruit off the island trees. Where the hour stands it neither ripens nor rots. It feeds, and closes wounds a little.
item.desc:salve: Berries and red mushroom bound on a wound with fibre. It closes the wound. A body takes only so much at once.
item.desc:greater_salve: Salve worked up with spore sac and glowing mushroom from the hollow. It closes worse wounds.
item.desc:tonic: Ground crystal in berry juice. Holders drink it at dawn. It eases a spent arm until the arm answers again.
item.desc:greater_tonic: Tonic with Salaha dust stirred in. Stronger, for an arm spent on a staff.
item.desc:ironbark: Bark steeped with brown mushroom and flint. For a while the skin is tougher.
item.desc:swiftroot: Yellow flower steeped with berries and fibre. For a while the legs are quicker.
item.desc:recall_stone: Cut lines and crystal round a Hīrak gem. Driven, it takes the bearer to the bed awake, shedding no lees. Then it cools.
item.desc:door: Planks hung on a frame. A ward stops no person, so no holder stays in a room without one.
item.desc:hollow_gate_kit: Black glass fitted round Kankāl Remains. Raised wherever the frame will stand, it opens on the hollow.
item.desc:rift_gate_kit: Tala bars round Jīmūt Remains, opening on the islands. Over open air it comes out on a foot of island rock.
item.desc:verdant_idol: A log with Kinva jelly bound into it with fibre. The born carve it and add a red flower. Vanahar comes up for the jelly.
item.desc:sunken_lure: Sandstone round raw meat and Angār dust, weighted with gold. It sinks in loose sand, and Maruhar finds it from below.
item.desc:warden_bell: An iron cup with Hīrak cast in its wall. Set mouth down on a Kankāl Altar, it holds Tama flesh and bone to the stone.
item.desc:spore_censer: Antar round Kavak sacs and a glowing mushroom. The sacs smoulder, and the smoke carries in the still air of the hollow.
item.desc:storm_kite: Crystal Fiber, grouse feather and a Tala bar, with Salaha dust. On its cord it lifts the dust to where Jīmūt feeds.
item.desc:prism_lens: Glass in a rim of Ākās, holding Sakal shards flat on a Ratan Altar. The born say the lens gathers light.
item.desc:eclipse_mask: Patik holding Chandasāvak slivers and Tama flesh, laid on a Kuranga Altar. Kuranga comes up for it at night only.
item.desc:cairn_key: A Hīrak Block bound in Gahan, charged with slivers and shards nobody drives. Nihān comes up through the base for it.
item.desc:strider_boots: Hide boots with feather worked into the lining. They are light on the foot.
item.desc:spring_anklet: Gold round the ankle over a pad of Kinva jelly. The foot comes off the ground higher.
item.desc:bounding_boots: Walking boots with an anklet's gold and jelly joined into the heel on the bench.
item.desc:iron_bracer: Iron plates riveted over hide, strapped along the forearm.
item.desc:briar_bracer: An arm guard with Kantak thorn joined into the iron. Whatever strikes it is cut.
item.desc:warriors_band: Iron and gold, worn high on the arm, with thorn set into the band.
item.desc:marksman_lens: Ground glass in a gold rim, held to the eye when the bow is drawn.
item.desc:reach_gauntlet: Hide to the elbow, plated with Jalit along the fingers. The hand reaches further in it.
item.desc:tide_fins: Webbed hide tied over the feet with fibre. In water they push hard.
item.desc:sages_ring: Crystal on a short line in a gold ring, worn on the driving hand. It eases the arm.
item.desc:mana_charm: Crystal on an iron mount, worn where the driving arm can use it. The arm takes more before it stops.
item.desc:soul_reliquary: The crystal of a charm and the gold case of a locket, joined on one chain.
item.desc:heart_locket: A small hinged case of gold, worn on a chain.
item.desc:duelists_sigil: An arm ring and an eyeglass worked into one band that sits over the knuckles.
item.desc:lucky_coin: A disc of gold with a lump of lees set in its face, rubbed smooth.
item.desc:magnet_shell: Iron beaten round a lump of rust out of a Nihirakka.
item.desc:binders_whistle: Bone packed with raw Tama flesh. A small feeder forms on the flesh, so one more stays by the hand.
item.desc:delvers_charm: Silahādak scale on gold, worn at the wrist. Rock loosens a little under the pick.
item.desc:shadow_cloak: Crystal Fiber woven with Tama flesh. Its edges are hard to see.
item.desc:cloud_bottle: Glass holding a wad of the pale stuff from under the islands. Let out under the foot, it bears one step in the air.
item.desc:feather_charm: Feather on a gold pin, over a pinch of the pale stuff. It takes the force out of a landing.
item.desc:gale_emblem: Bottle and feather charm worked into one piece. It gives a step in the air and a soft landing.
item.desc:skyrunner_treads: Boots with the pale stuff packed under the heel. A step in the air, and the drop taken out of every landing.
item.desc:mossheart_sprig: A shoot off Vanahar's body that still puts out leaf. Worn against the skin, it mends the body as a salve does.
item.desc:maw_fang: A tooth of Maruhar, the one part of it harder than its plates.
item.desc:wardens_aegis: A plate of Kankāl's pale set matter. It is dense, and whoever carries it is hard to knock off their feet.
item.desc:mycelial_crown: A piece of Guhamāt's cap. Small feeders form on it as they formed round the animal, and one more stays by the hand.
item.desc:tempest_feather: The pale stuff of Jīmūt's body. It bears weight and has almost none, and its wearer lands softly.
item.desc:prism_core: The densest crystal there is, from Ratan. A line run to it loses less of what the arm drives.
item.desc:eclipse_shard: A tine of Kuranga, lees set hard and pale. It loosens a little wherever the bearer strikes.
item.desc:sovereign_light: Cut housing with its gem still set in it, out of Nihān's body.
item.desc:pot_crystal: One crystal the shape of the inside of a jar, with flakes of fired clay still on it. Broken up, it is a lot of crystal.
block.desc:stone: The common rock under the soil. A pick brings it out as rubble.
block.desc:cobble: What a pick brings out of stone. A furnace closes it back into whole stone.
block.desc:deepstone: The darker rock below the stone, where the better ores lie. Maruhar's furnace is ringed with it.
block.desc:bedrock: The bottom of every dig. Black and cold, and no pick marks it.
block.desc:dirt: Soil under the turf. Like all ground here, it stays where it is put, even with nothing under it.
block.desc:grass: Grass with its soil. Where the flocks gone wild still graze, it stays open.
block.desc:sand: Loose and dry. Fired in a furnace, it runs to glass.
block.desc:sandstone: Sand that has lain long enough to set again.
block.desc:gravel: Loose stone from the deep sea floor. Flint turns up in it.
block.desc:clay: Dug from the shallows. It fires to brick, and every pot that holds lees is fired clay.
block.desc:snow: Snow that nobody has seen melt.
block.desc:ice: The sea frozen over in the cold country. It counts as ground, and breaks to nothing.
block.desc:mud: Ground in Panka that never drains. Lees that lies in it sets as it would in rock.
block.desc:snowy_grass: Turf with snow lying on it.
block.desc:scoria: Cindery rock round the molten rock, where the molten rock stands highest.
block.desc:nightglass: Glass formed where rock ran and set again, deep down. Gate frames and Kuranga's furnace are built of it.
block.desc:water: The sea and every channel lie at one height. No feeder comes up in water.
block.desc:lava: Molten rock, low down near the floor. It burns any body that goes into it.
block.desc:oak_log: Oak, the old wood of Vana. Cut one at the foot and the rest of the tree hangs where it was.
block.desc:oak_leaves: Oak leaves. Apples drop from them now and then.
block.desc:pine_log: Pine of the cold country. The villages of Tusāravan are built of it.
block.desc:pale_log: Birch, the first tree to seed into pasture that nobody grazes.
block.desc:kapok_log: Timber of the tallest trees, from the wet wood. In Kāsa the same tree stands thin, cut for fuel.
block.desc:kapok_leaves: Kapok leaves from high in the wet wood.
block.desc:rose_log: Blossom timber of Kusum. Nobody can say if it is an island tree or one of this ground.
block.desc:rose_leaves: Leaves and blossom of the Kusum tree.
block.desc:tall_grass: Long grass. Fibre comes out of it now and then.
block.desc:fern: Fern under the trees. Sometimes it gives fibre.
block.desc:flower_red: A red flower of the green country. The born put one on Vanahar's bait.
block.desc:flower_yellow: A yellow flower of the grass. Steeped, it goes into flower tea.
block.desc:flower_blue: Blue flower of the islands, found in patches all through the green country.
block.desc:flower_white: White flower of the islands. It grows on this ground too, thickest in Kusum.
block.desc:dead_bush: Dry bramble of the sand and the dry grass. It breaks into sticks.
block.desc:reeds: Reeds where grass meets water. They pull apart into fibre.
block.desc:mushroom_brown: Found in shade and underground. Stew and bark draught are made with it.
block.desc:mushroom_red: Salve and stew both need one of these.
block.desc:cactus: Spined, on the sand. A body that brushes it is cut.
block.desc:berry_bush: Wild berries on a low bush. Picked bare, it fruits again in time.
block.desc:glowshroom: A mushroom that gives light, so nothing comes up near it. It grows thick where kills were boiled down.
block.desc:coal_ore: Rock with old timber in it, charred black.
block.desc:iron_ore: Iron in the upper and middle rock, the one hard metal a wood fire will melt.
block.desc:gold_ore: Gold lying deep in the rock. An ordinary fire melts it out.
block.desc:mana_ore: Lees shut in rock and set hard into crystal. It gives light, and the rock hides it.
block.desc:lumenite_ore: Hīrak in the rock, low in the living ground and rare. The gem comes away whole.
block.desc:cindrite_ore: Ore of the lowest rock but one, beside the molten rock. It is still warm when cut.
block.desc:eclipsium_ore: The lowest rock there is, lying on the floor itself. Violet light shows through it.
block.desc:stone_bricks: Stone cut square at the workbench.
block.desc:mossy_bricks: Stone bricks gone green, with moss worked into the joints.
block.desc:sandstone_bricks: Sandstone cut square. The old villages of the sand are built of it.
block.desc:bricks: Clay fired hard in a furnace.
block.desc:glass: Sand fired clear. Broken, it leaves nothing.
block.desc:wardstone: Stone dressed by whoever built the old wards. It has lain dressed so long that it is harder than raw stone.
block.desc:torch: Coal on a stick. Nothing comes up in its light. What is already up walks into it.
block.desc:lantern: A torch in an iron case. Feeders do not come up inside its light.
block.desc:workbench: Four planks fitted square, with a true face and a vice. Tools, beds and draughts are made at it.
block.desc:furnace: Rubble round a wood or coal fire. It melts the soft ores, fires sand and clay, and cooks meat.
block.desc:chest: A box of planks. Ordinary goods in it draw nothing. Great remains in it make it a store.
block.desc:anvil: Iron heavy enough to stand under a hammer. Hard metal is shaped on it and Hīrak is split on its edge.
block.desc:emberforge: Maruhar Remains bedded in deep rock over a fire. The fire wakes them, and they loosen ore no fire moves.
block.desc:voidkiln: Guhamāt Remains in a ring of hollow rock with a fire under it. The ore it loosens never gets hot.
block.desc:prism_crucible: Ratan Remains ringed with island rock. Patik ore runs together in its bed.
block.desc:eclipse_forge: Kuranga Remains in black glass over a fire. It loosens Gahan, the ore that lies on the floor.
block.desc:tinker_bench: Vanahar Remains held between iron bars over a plank top. Two worked pieces laid against them press into one.
block.desc:runeloom: It holds a stave true while lines are cut along it, and fibre under even tension. Staves and totems are made on it.
block.desc:bedroll: Fibre over boards. After a fall we come out at the bed we last lay on. Old houses have them. No born person uses one.
block.desc:guest_bed: Hide over boards, for a householder to sit up on all night. In a closed, lit room with a door, one will come.
block.desc:crystal_cyan: Standing crystal, the azure of Tama lees. Its light stops feeders coming up round it.
block.desc:crystal_violet: Violet like the light of a Chandasāvak. It grows outward where lees set in the open.
block.desc:crystal_amber: Hangs from cavern roofs. Nobody has matched amber to any kind of feeder.
block.desc:iron_block: Iron bars packed into a block.
block.desc:gold_block: Gold bars beaten into one block. It stays soft.
block.desc:lumenite_block: Hīrak set together as a block. The Cairn Key is built round one.
block.desc:gloomstone: The rock of the hollow. Guhamāt's furnace is ringed with it.
block.desc:mycel: Fungus turf over hollow rock. Outside the hollow it grows only in the deep caverns.
block.desc:gloom_stem: Stem of a great fungus, the only timber in the hollow.
block.desc:gloomcap_teal: Teal cap of a great fungus. It gives a little light.
block.desc:gloomcap_violet: Violet cap off a great fungus, faintly lit from inside.
block.desc:umbrite_ore: Antar through the rock of the hollow, at every height.
block.desc:noctrium_ore: Tala, low in the hollow, down toward the standing water.
block.desc:lumen_frond: A frond of the hollow with its own light. Nothing comes up where it shines.
block.desc:sporelamp: Hangs from the hollow's roofs and gives a warm light.
block.desc:riftstone: The rock of the islands. Ratan's furnace is ringed with it.
block.desc:skyturf: Island turf, paler and bluer than the grass below.
block.desc:skysoil: Soil of the islands under the turf.
block.desc:star_log: Island timber. Its leaves give light, and nothing comes up under the trees.
block.desc:star_leaves: Island leaves with a light of their own.
block.desc:aetherium_ore: Ākās in island rock, the commonest ore on the islands.
block.desc:prismite_ore: Seams of island metal with crystal grown through them.
block.desc:cloud: The pale stuff that hangs in sheets under the islands. It bears weight and does not move.
block.desc:prism_crystal: Pale crystal of the islands, set harder than any other. Sakal feed on it.
block.desc:hollow_frame: Black glass round Kankāl Remains. Pull any piece and the opening shuts.
block.desc:rift_frame: Tala round Jīmūt Remains. With one piece taken out, the gate to the islands goes dark.
block.desc:altar1: A great housing on mossy brick, ringed by six living oaks. Vanahar comes up to bait laid in the hollow on top.
block.desc:altar2: On a gilded dais in a bowl of carried sand. Maruhar comes up through the sand. The rim is the footing.
block.desc:altar3: Ringed by pillars of stacked bone capped with azure crystal. Bait set on it brings Kankāl.
block.desc:altar4: In a domed cavern of the hollow. The smoke of its bait reaches Guhamāt in the roof.
block.desc:altar5: Masts of glassed stone stand round it. A kite goes up from here for Jīmūt, which never lands.
block.desc:altar6: On a made island of island rock among pale crystal pillars. Ratan answers bait here.
block.desc:altar7: Black glass and deep rock under the open sky. Kuranga comes up here only at night.
block.desc:altar8: The largest housing, on a raised base of dressed stone ringed with lamps. Nihān comes up through the base.
block.desc:moss_stone: Stone under moss. The paving round a Vanahar Altar is held together by moss and root.
block.desc:bone_block: Bone stacked solid. The pillars round a Kankāl Altar are built of it.
block.desc:gilded_bricks: Brick faced with gold. Feeders that eat stone get nothing from it.
block.desc:path: Earth packed hard between a village well and its doors.
block.desc:brood_nest: Feeders breed here, on stored lees whose salt failed.
block.desc:crate: A plank crate in an old house. Householders who pass through stock it.
block.desc:storm_block: Stone loosened by what Jīmūt throws and set again as glass.
block.desc:salt_crust: Salt dried white on the floor of a shore pan. It breaks to nothing.
block.desc:snow_prints: A print in the snow. A run of them begins in clean snow with nothing leading to it.
block.desc:ash_glass: Sand run to black glass under a fire that has burned kills for a long time. A piece sometimes comes away whole.
block.desc:great_fire: The one fire of a sand-country place, on its floor of black glass. It burns day and night and harms a body in it.
block.desc:charred_planks: Planks round a hearthstone, burned black. They will not burn again.
block.desc:rough_block: Cut free in a quarry and dressed on its top face. The other faces are raw stone.
block.desc:ward_core: A ward core like those cut at home: black, cold, heavier than stone many times its size. No tool marks it.
block.desc:cairn_base: Dressed stone from the base under the Cairn. Something has eaten into it from beneath.
rarity.desc:0: Surface matter and green work: timber, rubble, hide, fibre.
rarity.desc:1: Upper rock matter, worked by fire: iron and what is made of it.
rarity.desc:2: From the deep rock of the living ground: Hīrak and Jalit.
rarity.desc:3: Hollow matter, harder than anything of the deep rock.
rarity.desc:4: Island matter, set harder again than the hollow's.
rarity.desc:5: Gahan, which lay on the floor itself, and what is made of it.
rarity.desc:6: Made things that have lain made since the old stonework. Only Nihān has given any.
